'''Zuzanu Latt''' was a light-skinned [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial Navy Trooper|Imperial Fleet Trooper]] [[corporal]].<ref name="TOG" /> In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Corellia]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[13 BBY]].</ref> Latt was stationed in the [[Coronet City Spaceport|spaceport]] of [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] where the corporal and another [[trooper]] manned a elevated duty station that granted improved visibility. The podium was at one stage approached by the [[Ugor]] [[HarrGick]] and another individual while Latt was on duty.<ref name="TOG" />

The corporal and a college also stood in the podium when the criminals [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] entered the [[spaceport]], although one of the two troopers left the podium soon after their arrival. Both were back in the podium by the [[time]] the criminals set off an alarm as they passed through the spaceport's security.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Latt wore an entirely black [[Clothing|uniform]] including [[glove]]s, [[boot]]s, a [[belt]] with an [[officer's disk]], a [[Armor|chest plate]], and an [[Imperial Navy]] Trooper's [[plastoid]] [[helmet]].<ref name="TOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zuzanu Latt was portrayed by [[Zuza Tehanu]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|username=zuzatehanu|url=status/1521843152142938112|name=[[Zuza Tehanu]]|date=2022-05-04|quote=MAY THE 4th BE WITH YOU! Happy Star Wars Day! Throw back to when I was Corporal Zuzanu Latt in #starwars|archivedate=20220504132528}}</ref> in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Anthology Series'']] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The character was identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TOG" />
